svg.aria-label: Four rooms, four countries, four months of 2025. Each little figure is 25 people. Bali, August: 600+ applied for 100+ seats. Singapore, September: 4,000+ applied for 500 seats. Dubai, October: 600+ applied for 150+ seats. Buenos Aires, November: 1,200+ applied for 200 seats. In all, 6,400+ applied for 950+ seats.
